title: Georgia receiver and draft prospect Zachariah Branch arrested for misdemeanor obstruction

sources.name: ESPN NFL
sources.title: NFL draft prospect Branch arrested in Georgia
sources.description: Wide receiver Zachariah Branch, who is widely expected to be a Day 2 NFL draft pick, was arrested early Sunday morning in Athens, Georgia, on two possible misdemeanor charges.
